title: breynia microphylla
intro: Breynia microphylla, commonly known as Nine Herb Tea or Tieh Te Kow, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The health benefits of Breynia microphylla include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic agent, while its therapeutic actions include reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and preventing the formation of blood clots. The bioactive constituents of Breynia microphylla include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
